command: Run the pinned single-tile OS descriptor and the official padded.c macro sequence through the same retained RocketTile/GemminiRocketConfig harness; capture ordered funct3/funct7/rs1/rs2 commands, memory writes, completion/busy events, and output bytes. Use taskset -c 8-25, MemAvailable >10 GiB, at most -j4, and a memory cgroup.
success_condition: Descriptor and official C paths produce identical ordered RoCC command payloads, memory-write trace, completion behavior, and bit-exact output bytes without changing upstream Gemmini.
failure_policy: Stop at the first command/write/event divergence. Do not connect the clean-room gemmini_rocc_command_adapter to the official macro, invent PTW/TL behavior, relax numerical checks, or mark L2 PASS.
